# `MC_knlCalloc`

Allocate a zero-filled WIPI-managed memory block and return its memory ID.

## Prototype

```c
M_Uint32 MC_knlCalloc(M_Int32 size);
```

```{doxygenfunction} MC_knlCalloc
:project: libwipi
```

| ABI class | `word-tail` |

## Usage

Like MC_knlAlloc, this returns a memory ID rather than a stable native pointer.

### Parameters

| Name | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `size` | Requested zero-filled allocation size in bytes. |

### Return value

A nonzero memory ID on success, or the provider-defined failure value.

### Ownership

The caller owns the memory ID and releases it with MC_knlFree.
